details.question: 数据库里一共有多少位客户？
details.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers
details.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount FROM customers;

details.question: 有多少个国家有客户？
details.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Country) FROM customers
details.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Country) AS CountryCount FROM customers;

details.question: 总共有多少首歌曲？
details.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tracks
details.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TotalTracks FROM tracks;

details.question: 最贵的单曲单价是多少？
details.golden_sql: SELECT MAX(UnitPrice) FROM tracks
details.generated_sql: SELECT MAX(UnitPrice) AS MaxPrice FROM tracks;

details.question: 所有订单的总金额是多少？
details.golden_sql: SELECT SUM(Total) FROM invoices
details.generated_sql: SELECT SUM(Total) AS TotalAmount FROM invoices;

details.question: 每个国家的客户人数分别是多少？按人数从高到低排序
details.golden_sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customers GROUP BY Country ORDER BY cnt DESC
details.generated_sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(CustomerId) AS CustomerCount FROM customers GROUP BY Country ORDER BY CustomerCount DESC

details.question: 消费总金额最高的前5位客户是谁？他们各消费了多少？
details.golden_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS total FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5
details.generated_sql:
SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS TotalSpent
FROM customers c
JOIN invoices i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
GROUP BY c.CustomerId
ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC
LIMIT 5;

details.question: 2010年每个月的订单总金额是多少？按月份升序输出
details.golden_sql: SELECT strftime('%m', InvoiceDate) AS month, SUM(Total) AS total FROM invoices WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2010' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
details.generated_sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) AS Month, SUM(Total) AS TotalAmount
FROM invoices
WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2010'
GROUP BY Month
ORDER BY Month ASC;

details.question: 哪个流派的曲目数量最多？有多少首？
details.golden_sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM tracks t JOIN genres g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1
details.generated_sql:
SELECT g.Name AS Genre, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount 
FROM genres g 
JOIN tracks t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId 
GROUP BY g.GenreId 
ORDER BY TrackCount DESC 
LIMIT 1;

details.question: 每种媒体类型有多少首曲目？
details.golden_sql: SELECT m.Name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM tracks t JOIN media_types m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId
details.generated_sql:
SELECT mt.Name AS MediaType, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount
FROM media_types mt
LEFT JOIN tracks t ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId;

details.question: 从未下过订单的客户有几位？
details.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN invoices i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE i.InvoiceId IS NULL
details.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS UnorderedCustomers FROM customers WHERE CustomerId NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerId FROM invoices);

details.question: 从未下过订单的客户都来自哪些国家？
details.golden_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.Country FROM customers c LEFT JOIN invoices i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE i.InvoiceId IS NULL
details.generated_sql: SELECT DISTINCT Country FROM customers WHERE CustomerId NOT IN (SELECT CustomerId FROM invoices);

details.question: 单笔订单金额最高是多少？
details.golden_sql: SELECT MAX(Total) FROM invoices
details.generated_sql: SELECT MAX(Total) AS MaxOrderAmount FROM invoices;

details.question: 每位客户的下单次数和消费总金额分别是多少？
details.golden_sql: SELECT CustomerId, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt, SUM(Total) AS total FROM invoices GROUP BY CustomerId
details.generated_sql:
SELECT c.CustomerId, COUNT(i.InvoiceId) AS OrderCount, SUM(i.Total) AS TotalSpent
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN invoices i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
GROUP BY c.CustomerId;

details.question: 平均每张订单包含多少条订单明细？
details.golden_sql: SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM invoice_items GROUP BY InvoiceId)
details.generated_sql: SELECT AVG(ItemCount) AS AverageItemsPerInvoice FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS ItemCount FROM invoice_items GROUP BY InvoiceId);

details.question: 销售额最高的前5首歌曲是哪些？各自的销售额是多少？
details.golden_sql: SELECT t.Name, SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS sales FROM invoice_items ii JOIN tracks t ON t.TrackId = ii.TrackId GROUP BY t.TrackId ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 5
details.generated_sql:
SELECT t.Name, SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS TotalSales
FROM tracks t
JOIN invoice_items ii ON t.TrackId = ii.TrackId
GROUP BY t.TrackId
ORDER BY TotalSales DESC
LIMIT 5;

details.question: 销售额最高的前3位艺术家是谁？销售额是多少？
details.golden_sql: SELECT ar.Name, SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS sales FROM invoice_items ii JOIN tracks t ON ii.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN albums al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId JOIN artists ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 3
details.generated_sql:
SELECT a.ArtistId, ar.Name, SUM(i.Total) AS TotalSales
FROM albums a
JOIN artists ar ON a.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
JOIN tracks t ON a.AlbumId = t.AlbumId
JOIN invoice_items ii ON t.TrackId = ii.TrackId
JOIN invoices i ON ii.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
GROUP BY a.ArtistId, ar.Name
ORDER BY TotalSales DESC
LIMIT 3;

details.question: 美国客户的总消费金额是多少？
details.golden_sql: SELECT SUM(i.Total) FROM invoices i JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE c.Country = 'USA'
details.generated_sql: SELECT SUM(Total) AS TotalSpent FROM invoices WHERE CustomerId IN (SELECT CustomerId FROM customers WHERE Country = 'USA');

details.question: 哪个开票城市的订单数量最多？有多少单？

details.question: 有多少位客户登记了公司信息（Company 字段非空）？
details.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE Company IS NOT NULL
details.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount FROM customers WHERE Company IS NOT NULL;

details.question: 哪位员工负责支持的客户数量最多？带了多少位客户？
details.golden_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customers c JOIN employees e ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1
details.generated_sql:
SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS CustomerCount
FROM employees e
LEFT JOIN customers c ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId
GROUP BY e.EmployeeId
ORDER BY CustomerCount DESC
LIMIT 1;

details.question: 每位有下属的员工分别有多少个直接下属？
details.golden_sql: SELECT ReportsTo, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM employees WHERE ReportsTo IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ReportsTo
details.generated_sql:
SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(e2.EmployeeId) AS DirectReports
FROM employees e
LEFT JOIN employees e2 ON e.EmployeeId = e2.ReportsTo
WHERE e.ReportsTo IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName;

details.question: 时长超过5分钟（300000毫秒）的曲目有多少首？

details.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TrackCount FROM tracks WHERE Milliseconds > 300000;

details.question: 曲目数量最多的前5张专辑是哪些？各有多少首曲目？

details.question: 销售总额排名前3的流派是哪些？销售额分别是多少？
